verses.1: And he led me to the entrance of the house. There, I saw water flowing from beneath the door of the house. The water flowed downward from beneath the roof of the house, towards the south side.
verses.2: And he led me through the northern gate. Then he led me along a path leading to the outer gate. From there, I saw water flowing from the right side of the river.
verses.3: As the man stepped out, he held a spear in his hand. He crossed the river with difficulty, and I had to cross the water along with him.
verses.4: And he crossed over me in the waters of life. He passed me through the waters of my birth.
verses.5: And there were ten thousand streams that could not flow, because the waters rushed over them. It was impossible for those streams to continue flowing.
verses.6: And he said to me, “See, I have seen a human being. Take me and place me by the mouth of the river.”
verses.7: In my return, I saw that there was a very large tree by the stream’s edge.
verses.8: And the waters said to me, “These waters flow out into the ancient valley. They flow down onto the land. The days will come when these waters will become dry up.”
verses.9: And every living being that was killed would be brought back to life. All those who came there would live again. It would be a great blessing, for these waters would heal all those who came there.
verses.10: And there will be fish with eyes like those of fish, and also fish with fins like those of whales. They will be a kind of fish; their scales will be like the scales of the great sea fish. There will be many such fish.
verses.11: In their wounds and bruises, they will not be healed by salt. They were given to us in that state.
verses.12: And upon the river, there will be no trees that can be eaten. Their fruits will not be ripe for harvest. They will be used as food.
verses.13: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “The borders of the land shall be divided among two dozen of Israel’s tribes. All their debts will be settled.”
verses.14: And you shall inherit it as a gift from me, just like my brothers. I have laid my hand upon it for your ancestors, and thus this land became yours as an inheritance.
verses.15: And this is the boundary of the land, from the edge of the sea, along the path that leads to Bethany.
verses.16: The boundary between the territory of Damesh and the territory of Hamat, which lies along the border with Chavran.
verses.17: And there will be a boundary from the sea, along with the walls of Eynon, Dameshk, and Tsafona. There will also be a boundary along Hamat, and the area around Tsafona.
verses.18: And the borders of Kedim from between Chavran and between Dameshk, and from between Gilad and from among the land of Israel in the Jordan River, along the border towards the eastern sea. These are the borders of Kedim.
verses.19: And the border of Timna was marked off from the sacred land, all the way to the Great Sea. And the border of Timna was clearly marked on that land.
verses.20: And the sea that is so vast, from its edge all the way to its depths… this is the sea.
verses.21: And you shall divide this land among yourselves as the possessions of Israel.
verses.22: And you shall keep it as a sacred place for yourselves and for the foreigners who live among you. Those who are born in your midst will also be considered as part of your people. They will be like citizens of Israel. But those who fall into sin, they will be destroyed in the land of Israel.
verses.23: And on that day, when the stranger who lived there would die, their inheritance would be given to him. May the Lord say so.
